name: Open Money-Market Sub-Account
description: Opens a money-market sub-account for a specified member with an initial deposit.
goal: Open a money-market sub-account for member 100774 with an initial deposit of $1,000

inputs.name: memberId
inputs.description: The ID of the member for whom to open the sub-account.

inputs.name: initialDeposit
inputs.description: The initial deposit amount for the sub-account in USD.

outputs.name: confirmationNumber
outputs.description: The confirmation number for the sub-account opening.

outputs.name: accountBalance
outputs.description: The balance of the newly opened account.
